notes: Signing in to AniList works again. The rebuild hardcoded the API client of a different application, and AniList always sends the browser back to the Redirect URL registered against the client, so sign-in ended on that other application's own local address, which is not running on anybody's machine. The token was issued correctly and delivered nowhere. It now uses Anime Solution's own client, the one the 0.11 build used. The client is a setting again rather than a number baked into the build, and Settings has a field for it: anyone can register their own at anilist.co/settings/developer with the Redirect URL set to anisol://oauth.
